VoronoiMeshMaker¶

VoronoiMeshMaker is a C++20 library for clipped Voronoi mesh generation, domain construction, site generation, mesh topology storage, and export.

The current public direction is deliberately simple for users:

auto domain = vmm::domain::make_rectangle_2d(8.0, 4.0);
auto sites = vmm::site_generation::make_hexagonal_sites_2d(domain, 0.55);
auto result = vmm::tessellation::generate_clipped_voronoi_2d(sites, domain);
vmm::io::write_legacy_vtk_voronoi_cells_2d("mesh.vtk", "cells", result.cells, sites);

Note

The documentation marks implemented APIs separately from planned APIs. Several 3D and advanced mesh files are currently placeholders while the 2D clipped Voronoi pipeline is being completed.
